sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Sreng is an Irish hero. He is less known than Nuada, his foe in single combat in the first battle of Mag Tuired. Sreng was a warrior of the Fir Bolg. He went out to meet the invaders of the Tuatha Dé Danann. He saw that his people could not beat an enemy with magic weapons. His people would not listen to him. So Sreng fought the Tuatha Dé king Nuada. He cut off Nuada's arm. Nuada lost his kingship for a time. Sreng won the single combat, but his people still fell.
